canonical_definition:
What it is. Papers most commonly describe Lambada-OpenAI as a benchmark for evaluating language understanding, specifically the ability to model long-range dependencies in text through a text completion task. The operational detail that appears in the descriptions is a 0-shot setting.

What it is claimed to measure. Across the papers here, Lambada-OpenAI is used to measure Natural language understanding. It is linked to 1 construct and no behavioral indicators, so the reported use converges on a single construct rather than spreading across multiple targets.

Space of uses. The usage in the papers descriptions place Lambada-OpenAI within a language-understanding evaluation lineup alongside Hellaswag-0-shot, Winograd-3-shots, and WinoGrande-5-shots. Papers that specify the setup report it in 0-shot form, and no separate linked measurement instruments are recorded for it.
